title: Shot log
description: One record per source asset, produced by a footage-review subagent. The orchestrator merges these into the selects list. Everything needed to build the cut must be here, so nobody has to rewatch the footage.

mediaRef.description: The asset id exactly as get_media returned it. Short-prefix ids must be passed back verbatim, never padded or completed.

filename.description: Human reference only. Never judge content from it.

fps.description: Source fps. Flag when it differs from the project fps.

reviewed.description: True only if the agent actually called inspect_media on this asset. Never true by assumption.

unusable.description: Present only if the whole asset is unusable. States why (corrupt, black, <0.5s, hopelessly out of focus).

selects.description: Usable moments inside this asset. One long clip can yield several. Empty means nothing in it is worth cutting.

inSeconds.description: Source seconds. Pass straight to add_clips as source[0].

outSeconds.description: Source seconds. Pass straight to add_clips as source[1].

verdict.description: hero = earns a musical peak. keep = solid montage material. maybe = only if coverage demands it. cut = do not use.

energy.description: How kinetic the moment is. Drives which part of the energy curve it belongs to.

motionDirection.description: Used to find match cuts: a shot moving left cuts cleanly into another moving left.

action.description: What actually happens, in one concrete sentence. Written from the frames, not the filename.

subjects.description: Who is on screen. Drives the coverage map so no friend is missing.

audioNote.description: Any diegetic audio worth punching through the music: a scream, a laugh, a line of dialogue, a splash.

peakSeconds.description: Source second of the single best frame — the impact, the reaction, the reveal. Align this to a downbeat when the moment carries a musical hit.
